description: Defines the c10::QualifiedName struct for representing and manipulating qualified names with dot notation, including parsing, prefix checking, and caching of name components.

classes.name: QualifiedName
classes.description: Represents a dotted qualified name, providing parsing, prefix checking, and cached components for efficient name handling.

methods.name: QualifiedName(const std::string& name)
methods.description: Constructs a QualifiedName by parsing a dotted string into atoms.

methods.name: QualifiedName(std::vector<std::string> atoms)
methods.description: Constructs a QualifiedName from a vector of atoms, validating each.

methods.name: QualifiedName(const char* name)
methods.description: Constructs a QualifiedName from a C-string.

methods.name: QualifiedName(const QualifiedName& prefix, std::string name)
methods.description: Constructs a QualifiedName by appending a name to a prefix.

methods.name: isPrefixOf(const QualifiedName& other) const
methods.description: Checks if this name is a prefix of another.

methods.name: qualifiedName() const
methods.description: Returns the full qualified name string.

methods.name: prefix() const
methods.description: Returns the prefix part of the name.

methods.name: atoms() const
methods.description: Returns the list of name atoms.

methods.name: operator==(const QualifiedName& other) const
methods.description: Equality comparison based on full qualified name.
